Name: ShutDown
Description: Multi-key countdown that shuts down, restarts, sleeps, hibernates, logs off, locks the screen or turns off the display.

com.lukas.shutdown.master.Name: Shutdown Master
com.lukas.shutdown.master.Tooltip: Configure the countdown and start it. Hold to switch between Preview and Armed.

com.lukas.shutdown.child.Name: Shutdown Child
com.lukas.shutdown.child.Tooltip: Extends the master's countdown across more keys.
